# SendDock

> Open-source, self-hostable email marketing platform. API-first, BYO SMTP (Mailgun, SES, Postmark, any SMTP server), built with Go and Vue. Single-binary Docker deploy. AGPL-licensed Core plus license-gated Pro and Team tiers.

SendDock lets developers send transactional emails and run broadcast campaigns from their own infrastructure. Authentication uses cookies for the dashboard and per-project API keys (`Bearer <key>`) for everything else. Endpoints are REST + JSON over `https://<your-host>/api`.

## Getting started

- [What is SendDock](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/what-is-senddock): Overview, architecture, what Core vs Pro vs Team includes.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/getting-started): First project, first API key, first send.
- [Installation](https://docs.senddock.dev/self-hosting/installation): Docker Compose setup, required env vars, first-run admin user.
- [Configuration](https://docs.senddock.dev/self-hosting/configuration): All deployment knobs (deployment mode, license key, Postgres, Redis, SMTP).
- [Environment Variables](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/environment): Reference for every `SENDDOCK_*` variable.

## API reference

- [Authentication](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/authentication): Cookie session vs API key auth, header format, project scoping.
- [Code examples](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/code-examples): curl, Go, Node, Python, PHP snippets for the common flows.
- [Workspaces API](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/workspaces): CRUD for workspaces, members, role management (Team plan).
- [Projects API](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/projects): Create/update/delete projects, configure SMTP, bounce settings.
- [Subscribers API](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/subscribers): List, create, update, import (CSV/JSON with email validation), unsubscribe, suppression list. Typed custom fields (string/number/date/boolean/enum) and free-form tags, with bulk tag actions.
- [Segments API](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/segments): Saved subscriber filters (predicate: match all/any over status, tags, custom.* fields), live preview count, target broadcasts by `segment_id`.
- [Templates API](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/templates): HTML/text templates with `{{ variable }}` interpolation, including `{{custom.<key>}}` custom fields.
- [Email Sending API](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/sending): `POST /send`, `POST /send/batch`, `POST /broadcast`. Per-project rate limits, suppression-list handling, bounce classification.
- [Campaigns API](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/campaigns): Schedule and run campaigns over a subscriber list.
- [Suppressions API](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/suppressions): List, add and remove per-project suppressed addresses; what `/send` and `/broadcast` consult before every send.
- [Bounces API](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/bounces): Configure IMAP poller, webhook ingest URL and rotate the bounce token. Includes the public ingest endpoint shape (generic JSON + Mailgun).
- [API Keys API](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/api-keys): Create, list, revoke. Hashed at rest, shown once on creation.
- [Webhooks API](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/webhooks): Full CRUD + delivery history (Core, no license). Eight event types (`email.sent`, `email.failed`, `email.bounced`, `email.opened`, `email.clicked`, `subscriber.created`, `subscriber.unsubscribed`, `subscriber.newsletter_unsubscribed`), HMAC-SHA256 signing, exponential-backoff retries.
- [Analytics API (Pro)](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/analytics): Funnel, opens-over-time, top templates, top clicked links, trend pills, optional `segment_id` filter.
- [Audit log API (Pro)](https://docs.senddock.dev/api/audit-log): Read every sensitive action with actor, IP, metadata. Cookie-only.

## Feature guides

- [Workspaces](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/workspaces): Multi-user collaboration. Roles: `owner`, `admin`, `developer` (transactional only), `viewer` (read-only). Team plan.
- [Projects](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/projects): Project as the unit of isolation — own SMTP, own subscribers, own keys.
- [Subscribers](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/subscribers): Manage lists, import CSV/JSON with email validation (syntax + MX + disposable-domain block-list), waitlist endpoint. Custom fields (typed, project-scoped) and tags.
- [Segments](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/segments): Saved filters over status, tags and custom fields (match all/any) with a live match count; target broadcasts (and Pro analytics) at a subset.
- [Templates](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/templates): Reusable HTML/text bodies with variable substitution, including `{{custom.<key>}}`.
- [Email Sending](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/sending): Transactional vs broadcast, batch sends, suppression, bounce handling.
- [Campaigns](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/campaigns): Scheduled broadcasts with tracking and per-recipient unsubscribe URLs.
- [Suppressions](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/suppressions): Per-project list of addresses that never receive sends. Sources: hard bounce, unsubscribe, manual, bulk import.
- [Bounces](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/bounces): Three detection sources — in-session 5xx, public webhook ingest, and IMAP poller. Hard bounces auto-suppress.
- [API Keys](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/api-keys): When to use cookies vs keys; per-key rate limits.
- [SMTP Setup](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/smtp): BYO SMTP — Mailgun/SES/Postmark/Resend/custom. Encrypted password storage. Test endpoint with bounded timeouts.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/webhooks): Configuring endpoints, verifying signatures, retry behavior. Core — free, no license.
- [Analytics (Pro)](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/analytics): Dashboard usage, date presets, custom ranges, comparison windows, segment filter.
- [Audit log (Pro)](https://docs.senddock.dev/guide/audit-log): Append-only record of project, SMTP, API key, webhook, suppression and workspace changes. Per-entry actor, IP, metadata.

## Operations

- [Updating](https://docs.senddock.dev/self-hosting/updating): `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. Forward-only `goose` migrations on startup. Rollback steps included.
- [Troubleshooting & FAQ](https://docs.senddock.dev/self-hosting/troubleshooting): Common issues, log inspection, license validator failures.
- [Changelog](https://docs.senddock.dev/changelog): Version history, current latest is `0.6.0`.

- [Project on GitHub](https://github.com/arkhe-systems/senddock): Source, issues, releases.
